notes.title: Ver. 1.5 Update& MODULE CO-CREATION EVENT
notes.content:
Hi investigators, the version 1.5, inexhaustible concerto, has been updated!

The main content of this update is editor. After update, you can open it from the main screen.

[h3][b]Tutorial of editor[/b][/h3] (Only has Chinese for now, we will localise them into English when the editor is stable):
[url=https://meownaturn.yuque.com/cgigk7/depersonal style=button]Tutorial[/url]

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/181XJdypLrqmH7_XLNXtuljfNafG7J2HQCtFD5E54tjE/edit?pli=1#gid=0 style=button]Feedback&Editor feedback link[/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]【1. Text module editor】[/b][/h3]
In the first version, we mainly focused on the text module. You can open it in the main screen.
You can do following things in the editor:
[olist]
[*] Creating you own text module
[*] Changing current explore module
[*] Directly call in-game art, music, and other materials.
[/olist]
Currently the editor is biased towards the developer functionality version, and although we have written tutorial documentation, there is still a relative barrier to use. The functionality will be optimised in phases at a later stage to make it more streamlined and efficient.

[h3][b]【2. Module Co-creation】[/b][/h3]
With the available of editor, we plan to start some long-term module co-creation activities. For now, we have three formats of events. Here’s the overview:

[list]
[*] [b]Periodic activities[/b]
We will conduct module co-creation activities on a 3-4 month cycle and will choose/vote on a theme and start creating.
Every time we will set some rewards, such as Amazon Gift Card, commemoration in the Temple of Time and Space,  and our sincere love(what?)

[*] [b]Long-term activity[/b]
For investigators who don’t want to be restricted by the time/topic of events and want to create freely, we also have incentive programme, such as copyright inclusion, etc.

[*] [b]Optimize suggestion[/b]
If you don't want to participate in the creation activities m, but have suggestions for optimisation of the editor, we will also select some of the investigators to give out thank you packages.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Here's the details:[/h2]

[h3][b]Periodic activities[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Summary
We will conduct module co-creation activities on a 3-4 month cycle to call a themed module in the Steam Workshop.
First one, we choose the name of this version: inexhaustible concerto as the theme.
 
[*] How to vote
We take the form of recommendation scoring, by the investigators to form a recommendation group to recommend, and in the questionnaire to express their views, and finally we(the development team) will count the overall score.

[*] How to join
For everyone who want to make modules, please add our Discord group:

[*] Description of theme
Theme: "Unceasing" means non-stop, unending.
It can refer to the never-ending development of events, such as the resurgence of disasters.
It can also refer to the endless pursuit of human desires and pursuits, such as blood feuds and insatiable greed.
Of course, it can also refer to the spiritual inheritance on the level of consciousness, such as the faith that is awakened and the hope that is passed on to others.
(Sorry for my bad English, you can localize them to your friend or other players if you know Chinese well. Many thanks for your help!! Chinese version below: )
主题详解：“不息”为不停、不休止之意。
可指代事态发展永无终结、如灾祸卷土重来。
也可以指代人类的欲望与追求没有止境、如血海深仇的怨恨，无法填满的贪婪欲望。
当然也可以代意识层面上的精神传承、如被唤醒的信念，传递给他人的希望。

Regardless of the angle, it is always sufficient to interpret the theme of the session reasonably and convincingly during the course of the game.


[*] How to get a reward
We have set 5 types and there are 3 ways to get a reward:
[olist]
[*] The results of the votes cast by the members of the Recommendation Group are consolidated.

[u][b]Sorry everyone[/b][/u], because of the lack of human power and energy, we can’t organize the recommendation group for overseas players(but you can join the QQ group if you could) for the time being. So, for players outside of China who want to join the recommended group , we should say sorry. But we will also open the voting channel for you to choose the modules you like. (module authors can participate in the activity normally)
The voting is divided into three dimensions, which are:
[h3][b]Storytelling, Creativity, Gameplay[/b][/h3]

[*] Subscription popularity of Steam Workshop during the event
Besides voting, we will also collect the comments and like/dislike, etc. and will send rewards to the most popular module authors by subscription/rating.

[*] Prizes for participation
You can get the commemoration in the Temple of Time and Space only if you make a module and upload it to the Workshop.


Because this is the first time that we host such a event, depending on the number of submissions, the number of prizes or other awards may be increased and some of the prizes may be given to the same work over and over again, depending on the circumstances.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/6ce84b3509a1678c46ac78fcfe357b687ab4c8cc.jpg[/img]
[/olist]



[*] Description
[olist]
[*] How to attend
Upload your module to Steam Workshop and add keywords of this theme in the description. There is no limit to the number of characters/materials/scenes in the game.
[*] Module Type
Text module and the type is short module. The recommended range for optimal length is 30-120 minutes. Due to the many branching possibilities of the run module, there will be no upper limit to the total play time.
[*] Original Protection
In order to protect other people's work, we do not allow the publication of any content that is not authorised by the original author, such as removing, integrating, modifying or so on.
[*] NOTICE
Participation will be restricted to works with elements such as pornographic representation, excessive gore representation, and malicious denigration.
[/olist]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Long Term Module Incentive programme[/b][/h3]
[b]Summary[/b]
For those who don't want to be limited by the time/theme of the event, and want to create freely, or adapt the existing official modules, we have prepared a long-term creation support programme. There are two main types:
  ① Gift Card support
  ② Royalty (on computer software)

[h3][b]①Gift Card support[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]【Notes】
A long-term creative support programme for module authors to create their own stories. Module authors can create their own stories or adapt existing official modules without any time limit.
[*] 【How】
When your work meets a certain number of reviews and positive ratings in the Workshop, Amazon gift cards will be issued for the author.
[/list]

[h3][b]②Royalty[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]【Notes】
We will continuously screen and select high quality creative content, including but not limited to voice packs, localised translations, character models, game values, episodic modules, story modules and other types of mods.
If it meets the originality requirements, we will pay the royalties and include it in the game body with the author's permission.
[*]【How】
The incentives for this programme are royalties and non-exclusive agreements for the creator's work to be included in the game. As Depersonalization makes its way to multi-platform shelves, the artwork will be available on all platforms.
[/list]

[h2][b]Feedback & Suggestion[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Summary

We’re also very welcome for whom don’t want to attend the creation event but have suggestion for the editor. We will choose some players to send rewards as our many thanks!

[*] How to join
You can leave your feedback in the Online Documentation:
[url=https://docs.qq.com/sheet/DUllBb3hCSXBVYVln?tab=fv9f5l style=button]Feedback online doc link[/url]
If you don't feel comfortable with the online document, you can also send it to us at xiaoranmay@163.com

※We're a little slower to respond to email inboxes as opposed to online documents._(:з」∠)_
[/list]

At last
In fact, we don't really want to use words like reward/incentive to describe the co-creation activity, because we know that what the we can give to all the investigators is very limited, and can't fully match the creators' contribution to the game in co-creation.

At the same time, our awards can't cover every creator investigator, so in addition to adding the list of participants to the game, once again, we sincerely thank each and every creator, only you will make the playability and depth of content of Depersonalization expand to a level of possibility that we, the production team, will never be able to reach.
 
Also, since this is the first time we've planned this kind of event, we don't have a lot of experience... plus there's a certain threshold for the editor, so we're worried about a lot of things, such as whether or not there's going to be a lack of participation, whether or not the frequency/period of time/prize determination is going to be inappropriate, and so on and so forth...
 
But no matter what, we think the most important thing is to start from the first time, and we believe that with the improvement of experience and the editor, it will be better and better.
( •̀ ω •́ ) ✧

[h2]1. Regular Update Description[/h2]
Hi! Hi! Fellow investigators! (pop up
Since the last major release, we've maintained a weekly update schedule. We've adjusted our development plan. Instead of releasing a major version several months apart, we've kept a regular update frequency.

There are 3 main reasons for this:
1. Update the optimization from your feedback regularly. Avoid having to wait until the next big version for changes.
2. Relieve some development pressure. Spreading the update to small weekly phases, instead of preparing months for one version. 
3. Keep you guys updated as the game's continuously crawling towards the official release 

We'll be doing two updates this week. In addition to yesterday's regular Thursday update, today's update is 1.5 version of the text module editor (beta). Please give us some more feedback! Much appreciated!

Due to the unstable environment of the test, the content produced by investigators during the test period may not be fully preserved and inherited to the official version. If there are missing/crashing and other error reporting problems at the time, you can drop feedback through discord. We will arrange our programmer to troubleshoot.

The current text module editor is relatively basic. There are functions such as to replace game resources, modify existing configurations, quickly create modules, etc. Next we'll be adding new features and keep on updating, all the way to a full version, freely-created editor.

notes.title: The optimize direction about the combat feedback
notes.content:
[strike]（Here’s the answer if you don’t wanna look: Copy, we’ll change it）[/strike]
In response to some of the feedback we received about combat, we sorted it out and met to discuss it, and worked out some new optimization directions. Generally, there are three total categories of negative feedback around combat :
1.Higher percentage of combat
2.Higher combat difficulty
3.When creating characters, you can have better experience when using Thug.
We feel that some of the investigators' negative experience with combat is not just a matter of numerical difficulty. After discussion and analysis, we summarized the reasons that really affect the combat experience as follows:

【High combat difficulty】
It belongs to the combat positioning issue, we need to review the current division of the combat difficulty gradient, to see if the design of some monsters need to be adjusted, as well as will reorganize the threshold of props/equipment use.
[High percentage of combat]
This falls under the category of not enough combat mechanics. It needs to be optimized, and we need to find ways to boost the fun factor so that the combat isn't just a fight, but becomes an exploration expansion.
[Combat Profession Card]
After discussion, we feel that there are certain problems with the current career cards and are ready to re-optimize the overall career system to achieve balance.
===================
So for the optimization of the combat experience, we will not only make changes to the numerical values, but we plan to make adjustments in four directions: [Functionality threshold] [Level Design] [Core fun] [Occupational balance].
If we can adjust these then we should be able to successfully solve the above problems about combat.

[Functionality threshold]
Goal: In our original design, combat was positioned in the game not just as a fight, but as an extension of exploration. The hope was to allow all professions and all investigators to experience the fun of combat (rather than just the fun of fighting) equally.

Since different professions have different sense of reward when obtaining the same props, the sense of positive feedback is also different. For example:
For example, if a scholar and a fighter get a weapon at the same time, the fighter's positive feedback may have 70 or 80 points, while as for the scholar, because of the higher threshold, it may only be 10 or 20.(Scholar: what a noob! Take my disintegration!)
What we're trying to do is certainly not to diminish the thug's positive feedback, but to pull up the scholar's poor feedback. For example, by making the prop available to the scholar as well.

Optimization directions:
1) Enhance the overall guidance of the battle
Let the focus of the battle not be all in the direction of fighting, but in the direction of collecting and props. Here we will start designing props system 2.0, now the props system is more biased towards iconography, later the props system will be expanded.
2) Reorganize the plan
Look to see if there are any equipment/other things besides props that have huge thresholds that cause you investigators to not be able to pass your cards.
The adjustment here will not affect the investigators who love the combat type, because the essence of the run is the freedom and wireless extensibility, although now we can not perfectly restore this technical manpower and other reasons, but we hope to be able to make certain adjustments, so that each type of investigators can feel more fun in the game.

Difficulty gradient
The essence of the difficulty of the battle is the difficulty gradient, we have previously for the monsters have been divided into a few simple basic gradient:
Humans, Investigators, Monsters, Mythical Creatures, and Old Dominators.

For low gradient monsters, such as humans/monsters, our overall design of low intensity, normally even if you don't fight, in most cases, you can beat them by lulling/charming them.
For mid-gradient monsters, like mythological creatures, there will need to be key items to collect (such as Sky Denizen's Color of Stars, which can be passed directly after collecting the key props) (such as the Blood of the Gods to use ■■). Such creatures will have some specific weaknesses. Regardless of the investigator's profession, it will be easier to pass the level once the key props have been collected.

Our next plan is to focus on where some players find it difficult.

If the monsters in the low level flopped a lot (died from rats), then we would definitely make adjustments.
If it's in the mid to high gradient and still dies often when the investigator makes the right moves, we'll also make adjustments (dying is normal, but dying often and often is not...)
Our goal is for every investigator to feel that their card is useful in battle, regardless of profession (e.g. in battle, a fighter can fight, a scholar can negotiate, counter the enemy, etc. )

【3. Career balance】
After the current career system was discussed, it felt like there were some design flaws that resulted in the beater type career cards giving stronger positive feedback to investigators, while other careers didn't do the same.
So next we'll be retooling the career balance piece. Not to weaken the current occupations with strong positive feedback, but to strengthen the other occupations to achieve a balance in the feeling of use.

[4. Core fun]
The core fun direction of our battles is not focusing on such MMO things, but rather on the collect & use (What's this? Use! What's this? Use! What's this? Use!)
We'd like to make the combat part an exploration expansion, if combat is tied to exploration, then exploration is tied to what is collected. For the items obtained, how to use them, matching combinations. Will be our direction afterward.
Regarding the next adjustment, we are going to target the [items/monsters] section, reorganize the relationship with each other, and improve the correlation between monsters and props. 

That's all we're going to talk about this time. If you got anything to share or feedback, you can [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/181XJdypLrqmH7_XLNXtuljfNafG7J2HQCtFD5E54tjE/edit?pli=1#gid=0]click here[/url].

- If it's in the mid to high gradient and still dies often when the investigator makes the right moves, we'll also make adjustments (dying is normal, but dying often and often is not...)

notes.title: The first major update -- Invitation from a New Dimension is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/26dcc6dbd6d19ac9f519f54ecfaf9f86df14e418.png[/img]
Hello investigators!
The first major update of Depersonalization is available now! Besides the two modules previously previewed. We've also optimized countless [u](STILL COUNTABLE)[/u] game content. In this version, we've made some new In this update, we have made some new attempts. To be honest, we're a bit apprehensive, so we really need your feedback!
We created an online Google doc to collect the feedbacks.
You can find it here: [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/181XJdypLrqmH7_XLNXtuljfNafG7J2HQCtFD5E54tjE/edit?pli=1#gid=1978607598]Please click here[/url]
Or you can join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/EXzmyDK78p]Click here[/url]

About the localization you feedback. We've already start the cooperation with another professional team. They're localizing the new 2 modules. But because of the tight time, we can not input them in the game in this version. You can see them in the next version.
And we're keeping our best to contact a localization team with a free time to fine-tune our previous 4 modules to increase the sense of immersion.


You can check the details below:
(BUT don't forget to check the last part)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/f413030674d1b2748d20ce7cc7dba24eab02164b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]New module type[/b][/h3]
[b]Text module[/b]
【Function】
Text module is based on text content, omit the existing exploration scene and character resources, and build the stage for the scene. In order to lower the cost of crowd-creation content in the future, we have overhauled the presentation of the text module in this version to bring it in line with the configuration of the exploration module.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/3a43f8325b02e2759fab9948c26920c3ff365337.png[/img]

[b]Rules module[/b]
【Function】
A module type for enhanced event triggering, map movement, and action power. Investigators need to control their action power and dig out clues to events that will lead to the right ending.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/c0090d861c65c047e57969c911e1e50d633046e4.png[/img]


[*] [h3][b]Workshop: MOD Resource Manager[/b][/h3]
We've overhauled and optimized the underlying codes to make sure it can support underlying functional support for the Workshop content. Make all resource configurations readable via the resource directory for in-game and external mod-loaded resources, such as sound and images.
How to use: 
Please subcribe out example here and find the file with these steps below: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2998484469]Click here[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/9e329b74edb74350c15dc3927583d7e8b2f24eb6.png[/img]

[*] [h3][b]Support controller & full keyboard interaction[/b][/h3]
The new version supports controller interaction. Meanwhile, the UI will also be completely reworked as some of the original interfaces were not adapted to controller operations, such as backpack, create characters, etc.

Besides, when you first play it on [u][b]SteamDeck[/b][/u], you should do the following to enter the game successfully:
[b]1. Manage(The gear icon) → Properties → Compatibility → Force the use of specific steam play compatibility tools[/b]

[b]2. Controller manage (the controller icon) → Current Layout → Templates → Gamepad With Joystick Trackpad → Apply the layout[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/de200bcbf95096c9ede927824f5337d74a989910.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [h3][b]QOL improvement[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Combat[/b]
We add some convenient functions in the combat, like re-start the battle quickly, forfeit, and adjust team member’s position. Moreover, you can check the tips related to some enemies in the battle now.
[*] [b]Re-roll with Luck[/b]
Now the logic of re-roll with Luck consumption has been adjusted. 
As the Luck consumes, players will be more likely to get a result that would otherwise be harder to get.
[*] [b]Ending Records[/b]
Now you can reload after the Scenario Settlement, and then try other endings from a previous point.
The points that could be reloaded in the module is moved from pre-settlement to post-settlement..
Now you can use one single character to experience all the ends then choose one to record. And now, you also unlock all the ends in this module.
[*] [b]Refine System[/b]
For a better experience, we have not only made the processing interface full-screen, but also modified and reconfigured the processing list.
Players can take the method of consuming extra materials to complete the processing directly without checking.
[/olist]
[*] [h3][b]New optimization[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]General[/b]
Now the Skills required for important branches during exploration can be replaced, as well as the option to add remedies after fail check.

[*] [b]Active action function[/b]
Players can now actively perform some actions now in the exploration.
For example:
Hiding to avoid enemies in chase;
Heal without relying on healing items
Consuming one turn to make some Character's status changes.
Removing infected tissue. (You can actively remove parasitic effects outside of combat.)
[/olist]

[*] [h3][b]Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Interface of Character's information[/b]
Because of the controller support and new functions, the old interface of Character's info is not enough for all the information now.
So we have turned it into a full screen and added some new tabs for every character to be able to display more information.
Except for the current info, you can also check Character's Myth item projection and Profession. Now you can edit Myth item projection for each character and not affect others. The consumption of projection will also change from continuous consumption to one-time consumption.
The experience interface also allows you to view a more detailed record of your character's experience in the module.

[*] [b]Projection[/b]
The projection function of Myth items is associated with the information of the character, and each character can record his own set of myth items.
Once a character's projection field is unlocked, it is permanent and does not need to be consumed each time it is projected.
The myth items projection function that was required at Sothoth has now been moved to the character information, and each character can now edit and save their own myth items projection separately.
Each character initially has one projection field by default, and can consume time and space points to permanently unlock the remaining two.

[*] [b]Equipment Wearing Logic[/b]
To avoid some extreme situations, we have added new categories -- Books and Clothing.
A character can equip one book and one piece of clothing at a time. In addition, some items carried by NPCs will become binding items, and the binding items cannot be removed from the character by "Assigned to teammates". Myth items brought into the module by the character through projection will automatically add an equipment binding effect.

[*] [b]Experience[/b]
We have added alternative checks to more than 40 places in the original four modules that need to be checked with a skill attribute. Players can more freely choose the skills to test.
Characters are able to use the skills they are good at to pass a certain check. And we canceled more than a dozen of checks that are purely interaction of resource acquisition, and now you can directly obtain these resources.
[/olist]
[*] [h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]
[b]Rules[/b]
[olist]
[*] Add a cap to skill modifiers for [Energetic] and [Weakened]: The upper limit of Energetic is 20. The maximum cap on skill impairment from Weakened is 20.

[*] Add a cap to skills and Attributes: The upper limit of basic attributes is 90. The upper limit of native skills is 80, and the upper limit of non-native skills is 60.

[*] Some effects may adjust to these caps. (These limits are only in effect for investigators and humans, monsters and others are not subject to this limit)

[*] Added [Massive Size] status to some of the larger enemies:
In contrast to [Small Size], a bonus dice will be added to the attacker when these [Small Size] enemies are attacked from long range. This change will be applied to some of the enemies in the first four modules.

[*] The bonus for the full amount of damage dealt by an attack action with a large success has been reduced from 1.5x to 1.2x. This change will take effect for both the enemy and us.

[*] When re-entering combat from the character death screen, it restores all friendly HP to max.
[/olist]

[*] [h3][b]Others[/b][/h3]
[b]【Myth item】[/b] -- Atlach Doll: Character gets Strength +20, Constitution +20
[b]【Myth item】[/b] -- The Pearl of Nacha: Occultism +10. Every time you start a battle, Summon a spider monster at your front position.
[b]【Myth item】[/b] -- Yithian Lightning Gun: Damage range: 3-10 → 7-14
[b]【Myth item】[/b] -- Cultes des Goules: You will not accquire Implant Fear now.
[b]【Trait】[/b] -- The One Who Doesn't Exists: While [Wake], when you lose SP, you will lose 3 HP instead but the HP will not be reduced to less than 1.
[b]【Trait】[/b] -- Famous Song: You can only trigger it when [Weakened] or [Psychasthenia].
[b]【Trait】[/b] -- Workaholic : You will get " Luck -5, SP-5, Money +200" when enter the module.
[b]【Trait】[/b] -- Scarred: The effect of Scarred now is shown as BUFF.
[b]【Item】[/b] -- Nunchakus: The trigger condition of 4 consecutive attacks is adjusted to trigger when Agility ≥ 70.
[b]【Item】[/b] -- Monocle: Intelligence +10. If you have 5 clues at least, you will have a bonus dice in Observe and Perception Check.
If you have 10 or more clues, whenever a battle begins, expose a random enemy's weakness.
If you have 15 or more clues, Your successful [Conceal] in combat will additionally add the [preparing for attack] status.
[b]【Item】[/b] -- Hiking Boots: Add a new effect. All friendly summons gain a bonus dice in all checks.
[b]【Magic】[/b] -- Create Mist: 1 bonus dice → 2 bonus dices.
Change consumption of some Magic.

Add new Myth item【Black Fan】. You can get it after defeating The Bloated Woman in the module -- Lies and Fraud.

The synthesis recipe of [Spear] has been added to the processing recipe.

[*] [h3][b]Interlude[/b][/h3]
Add an effect "retrieve oneself" of vacation in Interlude. It will resets the investigator's SP to equal the current Willpower, but does not cause the SP to exceed the upper limit.
In Study, all study projects will return 2 points of Development Phase Time after failure.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/25ed635037944d1306b25c54305c1a5bb413aec1.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] [b]Text module editor[/b]
[list]
[*] UI, the simple configration of rules module and text module and Creative Call for Entries.
[/list]

[*] [b]English localized version[/b]

[*] [b]Real human voice over for All-in-One and One-in-All[/b]

[*] [b]Steam achievements, optimization of the July version, the function of history records in the exploration module.[/b]
[/olist]

[h3][b]What will we do in the current plan?[/b][/h3]
July 5th - July 19th     Stabilize the version
July 19th - Aug. 15th     The editor of text module; optimization
Aug. 15th     Receive an another English verson of new content	
Aug. 15th - Aug. 30th     QA & LQA

[h3][b]Others in plan[/b][/h3]
Finish the module process of CURSENDAY BLACK CARNIVAL.				
Finish the toturial plot.
Finish the optimization plot of combat.
Finish the plot of Friends system.

notes.title: Announcement regarding Depersonalization major update release date
notes.content:
[b]Sorry investigators! We have to postpone the major update until July 5th![/b]

[h3][b]NOTICE: All images will be replaced with English versions later.[/b][/h3]
The main reason is that we've been reworking some of the new features, and with half of the studio being bedridden because of the COVID 19... We’ve set up a one-month long debug plan after the development done, so we'll have to postpone it until July 5th.
We’re very sorry for the delay.

About the details of this update, you can check it here:

notes.title: Teaser for the update of Depersonalization
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We plan to update the version on [b]June 15th at the latest!![/b]

Although it looks like very justified, it's actually a month's delay compared to the previous schedule we talked in this Spring...But we have a REASON! The main thing is that we want to update both [b]2 NEW module types[/b] and [b]the corresponding NEW stories[/b] this time. And of course some optimization. 

So after all things considered, we're going to build on this update by incorporating some of the content in summer and combining it together into one big release.

[i][b][h3]Notice:[/h3] [/b][/i]This update does not include the Cursenday module. The main reason is the lack of manpower & effort, so we plan to update this module in Winter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/3d515d904ce3ec06ab3ed555be4109dac6f2090e.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] [h3][b]2 new types of module: [/b][/h3]

[b]·[/b] [b]【New version of text module】[/b]
“How to fight in text module?”, ”How to make a team in text module(not online of course)?”, ”How to use items in text module?”All these questions has been treated in this new version of text module. 
Generally, for investigators who are good at creating settings can only set the story structure/character content and upload some of the art resources(such as background art/stand-ups, etc.) to create a text module which looks like a novel.

[b]·[/b] [b]【Rules module】[/b]
This genre was created for the Workshop which can support all kinds of self creation in the future, such as anime/novels/rules play/suspense. In this type,  each identity of a character is determined by the module, and the are no limits in the growth of career changes, item acquisition, collection and others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/36ac9f3dfc32044a79829e000d30857dbf7fb90d.png[/img]

We would have liked to give a general preview of the stories of the corresponding new module, but it's a busy time for changing the setting, so we won't show much details in this announcement. [b]But we will give come back with a report in the April monthly report when the direction is confirmed.[/b]

[*] [h3][b]The return of AI Yog-Sothoth[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] [b]Now Yog-Sothoth has been connected to the ChatGPT,[/b] conversations will be much smarter than before! As long as there are no unexpected things that necessitate a delay, this will be ready for you in the new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/53000561b9b46361bce203f62f1ac2833a960247.png[/img]

[*] [h3][b]Workshop: MOD Resource Manager[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] We’re currently in the process of overhauling and optimizing the underlying codes to make sure it can support underlying functional support for the Workshop content: Make all resource configurations readable via the resource directory for in-game and external mod-loaded resources, such as sound and images.

[*] [h3][b]Support controller & full keyboard interaction[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] The new version will support controller interaction. Meanwhile, the UI will also be completely reworked as some of the original interfaces were not adapted to controller operations, such as backpack, create characters, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/f5dcc2c47da4ed4107711f19a645f32b06989bdd.png[/img]
[*] [h3][b]Profession System[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] The Profession system is a new system for the rule play module, where players' characters can obtain some special items in this module and bring back to the Space-Time Temple to activate and enhance their Profession.
[b]·[/b] Advanced Professions will be more like an ability that resembles a trait but takes on a different role. Plus, some modules in the future will also have Class and Level requirements for characters.

[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/b4bd4dd41c86dfe2eb333eaddadb5411c1dee51b.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] [h3][b]QOL[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] [b]Combat:[/b] We add some convenient functions in the combat, like re-start the battle quickly, forfeit, and adjust team member’s position. Moreover, you can check the tips related to the enemy in the battle now.

[b]·[/b] [b]Check success rate indication:[/b] You can see all the factors that will affect the final success rate before the test.

[b]·[/b] Re-roll with Luck: Now the logic of re-roll with Luck consumption has been adjusted, as the number of re-rolls increases, players will be more likely to throw a result that would not otherwise be easy to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/6f6535c5b7ee3ac111d8dab52d694e7b8fc74fc2.png[/img]·

[*] [h3][b]Exploration[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] [b]General:[/b] Now the Skills required for important branches during exploration can be replaced, as well as the option to add remedies after fail check.

[b]·[/b] [b]Active action function:[/b] With this new function, players can take some actions now in the exploration. For example, hiding to avoid enemies in chase, heal without relying on healing items, consuming one turn to make some Character's status changes, and some actions that could otherwise only be performed in combat, such as [removing infected tissue].

[*] [h3][b]Optimization of Ending Records/Interface of Character's information[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] [b]Ending Records[/b]
Now you can reload after the Scenario Settlement, and then try other endings from a previous point.

[b]·[/b] [b]Interface of Character's information[/b]
Because of the controller and new functions, the old interface of Character's info is not enough for all the information now. 

So we have turned it into a full screen and added some new tabs for every character to be able to display more information. 

Except for the current info, you can also check Character's Myth projection and Profession. Now you can edit Myth projection for each character and not affect others. The consumption of projection will also change from continuous consumption to one-time consumption. 

Besides all the things above, the experience interface also allows you to view a more detailed record of your character's experience in the module.

[*] [h3][b]Refine System[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] For a better experience, we have not only made the processing interface full-screen, but also modified and reconfigured the processing list.

[*] [h3][b]Equipment Wearing Logic[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] To avoid some extreme situations, we have added new categories for books and clothing.

[b]·[/b] A character can equip one book and one piece of clothing at a time. In addition, some items carried by NPCs will become binding items, and the binding items cannot be removed from the character by "Assigned to teammates".

[*] [h3][b]Others[/b][/h3]
[b]·[/b] We have added alternative checks to more than 40 places in the original four modules that need to be checked with a skill attribute. Players can more freely choose the skills to test. 
Characters are able to use the skills they are good at to pass a certain check. And we canceled more than a dozen of checks that are purely interaction of resource acquisition, and now you can directly obtain these resources.
[/olist]

notes.title: [Monthly Report] QA & MOD tools description & Sothoth AI will return
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After the launch last year, we’ve received plenty of suggestions and feedback. So for 3 months after the launch,[b] we’re kept fixing BUGs and optimizing while we were busy with the development of the new version[/b]. And as the development is now gradually stabilized, we would like to share the development progress to you in a more timely manner.

Therefore, in the middle of each month, we will update the monthly report to show our work to you. If you have any question, please don’t hesitate to leave a message, or join our community!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/etrXtDaEww]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/meow_nature]Twitter[/url]

[h3][b]QA[/b][/h3]

[b]Q: Will you fix the problem that the character can be stronger with no limit?[/b]
A: We will give a upper limits and balance with an expanded career system, and limit career types for some modules.

For example:
For each character, in addition to the job(primary job) you choose at the beginning, you may have some advanced jobs to choose. The possible effects are:
1. Increase the upper limit of the specified skills/attributes of the character
2. Increase the character's native skills
3. Give the character one or more additional traits while the job is in effect.

[b]Q: The current tutorial is not enough to understand some settings[/b]
A: The more detailed tutorial has been scheduled. We expect that we can begin in the summer.
Previously, because of the lack of manpower and time, the tutorial is abbreviated, after which we will carry out more optimization.

[b]Q: Can player-made modules be associated with the Space-Time Temple?[/b]
A: That’s free, we have no explicit restrictions.
If the content creators are willing to add plot eggs of the Space-Time Temple, but at present we are not too satisfactory for this piece of the settings. The future expansion of the Space-Time Temple still needs to accumulate a period of time. But what won't change is that our goal for the Space-Time Temple is to provide support for the many story modules.

[b]Q: Can I customize the resources in the module?[/b]
A: Great question! This is really being done!
We are currently overhauling and optimizing the underlying code so that all resource configurations can be read from within the in-game and external mods.

[b]Q: What does the Mod making tools like?[/b]
A: Because we opened the MOD, in order to meet the creative will of the creators and to approach the goal of a future where everyone can participate in the creation, we have designed different types of modules to meet the needs of different creators.

For example, for creators who like story content, we have prepared a new version of Text module. Creators only need to focus on story structure and character as well as some character resource packs, and background image.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/165b20c8768e026070867a76b60ff9284064cb6c.png[/img]

For creators who love reasoning and level design, we’ve made the Rules Play Module(the upgraded module). You should control yourself and then solving different problems and solve the risk at the end.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/18ad850187a5d450572637e1a53de6eb2a7cd548.png[/img]

The last one is exploration module. It doesn’t has specific editing interface, but the approach is definitely to select existing resources and generate rooms by dragging and dropping configurations.


[b]Q: What’s the intended solution to the problem that the current dice mechanism has too much randomness.[/b]
A: We've added several skills to exploration process to check the important branches.
Choosing the right skill will make it easier to succeed, while penalties will exist for unsuitable skills. Also if an important check fails, we allow another remedy after the failure.

[b]Q: Will the game have a replay function?[/b]
A: Yes, but we will achieve it more efficiently, such as the current text module.
In order to make it more efficient for creators to join the module, we are now working on a new version of the text module feature. It requires the recording of individual actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/e478ac241b2acf6717499b305274595ec9cb48da.png[/img]

[h3][b]New features has been finished. AI Sothoth will return! Maybe we will update it in the next update.[/b][/h3]

Now Sothoth has plugged into ChatGPT's interface, [b]the character's dialogue will be much more intelligent than before.[/b]

This feature maybe updated in the next update. What worth noting is that we will support MOD for ChatGPT's training guide as well, so investigators who are interested in this piece can try it afterwards.

[u][b]P.S.[/b][/u] 
[b]Because it is a private key, there will be concurrent problems for multiple people to access the processing,
so the configuration of the MOD supports modifying the key to your own private access key. if you are worried about exposure to the public, please be sure to modify the MOD to be visible only to yourself or your friends.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/2b350aac4e749c7ebf86a918e96f59f47b75b920.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/fc870b6a65e61b72210dbc33123feb8f6eff1fe5.png[/img]

[h3][b]New optimization: General interaction optimization completed[/b][/h3]
Because the current version of the skill check is too much consideration for the experience of multiple characters to pass the module, but not to fully consider the single character to reach all ends. Therefore, if the character wants to carry out an action, they often can not succeed and feel uncomfortable because the "unlucky" roll.
So we added skill substitution to some important branch-selected actions. And added the option of remedies after failure. When an action is to be performed, choosing the right method will make it easier to succeed, while the wrong method will have penalties.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/d9aa68d3491a8f516c0fa7a55f4169f38b699d2f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/09b7f6c3f74120f7460d1b007cfbc74cf2b3e89c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/a2b541bcb18c498f89b3015d4cffd0825329f843.png[/img]

[b]What needs to say is:[/b] Some special action doesn’t need a skill check, such as using money to buy someone, open the room with a crowbar, processing synthetic items, all can exist a certain success method.


[h3][b]Other notes[/b][/h3]
[u][b]The above schematics are development design draft, everything is subject to the final actual update.[/b][/u]
In addition, due to the limitation of graphic space, the details that can be displayed are limited.
Besides the above, the rest of the work is also in progress, such as modules with new contents, controller interaction features, functional gameplay modules. And various optimizations: like text module, generic interaction optimization, hint messages, dice check, etc.

In the following monthly reports, we will try to release the work that has been completed, or is largely completed, and for the work that is under development, please acquiesce that we are working intensively on it. 

Because we want to express our sincerity with the completed progress, preferably already the finished picture, obvious progress effect. And not just some plans and development lists, so that the unfinished work is not described afterwards.

[h3][b]At the end[/b][/h3]
Finally, thank you all again for your support!
We know that we can't get this far without everyone's tolerance and encouragement. There is still a lot of room for improvement in the current content of Depersonalization, and the playable modules need to be filled with more content. We also want to link up with many of the biggest players in the world, and we have the creative workshops and online features that we promised before...

We will continue to update for a long time, perhaps encountering some unexpected difficulties, or perhaps some of the content presented in the middle is not satisfactory to you. But we will not give up and keep working hard towards the goal, and accept your feedback, constantly to create new modules, optimization, and achieve our promised goal little by little.

Finally, finally, thank you again for accompanying us to grow, and we will try to present you with good content!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/008d2ee82058c4d299ef9781327074476a92b4a4.png[/img]

notes.title: Ver. 1.3.19 patch notes, BUG FIXES, Optimization and a new important feature!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We finally make a big update in the first month! In this update, [u][b]we made some new features[/b][/u] and of course serval bug fixes and optimizations. But this is the first time that we make a Workshop, so there are not many interfaces open this time.

[h3][b]功能新增[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] You can check the Roadmap in the login screen.
[*] You can check your savedatas in the login screen.
[*] Add Workshop interface. Now you can experience some initial custom mod functions(We will keeping adding more features in the future). Here are some simple and convenient functions:
[olist]
[*] Localization. You can add your own language in the game now.
[*] Custom voice. Now you can upload the voice files of all texts you made.
[*] We have created new config files. Now you can add or modify contents of Text module！
[/olist]
[/list]

[h2][b]Introduction about Workshop[/b][/h2]
The game currently supports external configuration import, when the game detects the module that subcribed in Workshop, it will actively load the local Workshop downloaded file after entering the game.
Here's the Steamcommunity Link:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1477070/workshop/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/c4383b8f27fb5de22cdce3c2056e85227f20d507.png[/img]

When the module is subscribed and downloaded successfully, a new module option will be added in the game.
[b](Notice: Currently the game does not support dynamic refresh of subscription module,so each time you  need to restart the game to update)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/84f4652ba661c09f39cefaa7a810e087b9e9f325.png[/img]

In addition to the switch button of module, there's also a priority input box. When there is a conflict between multiple identical modules, the module with the higher priority (larger number) will take effect first.

Due to the simplicity of the Workshop functions, the following will be a direct description of the supported MOD functions:
[list]
[*] [url=https://docs.qq.com/doc/DSWN3Wm9yQlp1TVdh]MOD-- Create new Localization files[/url]
[*] [url=https://docs.qq.com/doc/DSVZvSUpMSnBhRE96]MOD-Create new voice files[/url]
[*] [url=https://docs.qq.com/doc/DSXdoZ2R0V1BOSnZ1]MOD-Create config files[/url]
[/list]


[h3][b]Optimization:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The trait Blessing of the Spider God has been changed which has two different effect while Wake and Sleep. New effect wile Sleep: 
[*] Recover 1-3 SP whenever you win a battle.
[*] The name and description of the action has been adjusted for whether the target is in an inoperative state during Search in Battle.
[*] Adjustments for the Refine System: Some items don't need to be checked when crafting. Some items can be crafted with different skills (you can switch the recipe in the interface to see). Adjustment for the crafting consumption and disassembly consumption of some items.
[*] Restrictions on clicking the battle log button when the prompt text for the start of a round appears.
[*] Optimize the calculation logic for the effect of A Piece Leave of Green God.
[*] Optimize the damage effect of fumble of Concealment.
[*] Optimize some localization.
[*] No more Pop-ups of spells gained in the Scenario Settlement (this does not affect the spells Anan forgot that he managed to remember)
[/list]


[h3][b]BUG FIX:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that the Deconstruction of reason trait could cause attributes to not be retained correctly when switching between Wake and Sleep.
[*] Fix a bug that the effect of Beasts in the Shadow cannot decrease Willpower to 0 when the True Love trait take effect.
[*] Fix the bug that Flower of Blood doesn't take effect when enemy in the front line dies.
[*] Now the Voorish Sign sound effect will not continue to play when returning to the lobby after it has taken effect.
[*] Luck can be consumed to 0 now.
[*] The last character model selection residue is now cleared when creating a new character.
[*] Added a pop-up prompt to delete the archive when entering the module.
[*] Adjust the sonsumption of attributess while using a spell.(Notice: The Mana consumption of a spell is not counted as a "SP drain" when interacting with other effects if it is converted to a SP drain when your Mana is low.)
[*] Fixed a bug that when performing a search action within a battle could cause the item to not be removed from the target.
[*] Fix a bug that temporary bonus dice were not cleared instantly in some cases, which resulting in abnormal results.
[*] Thanks for players, we found a Time Paradox in All-in-One and One-in-All and we fixed it.

[/list]

notes.title: Introductions about some big problems we meet now
notes.content:
We have received a lot of BUG feedback and suggestions for optimization from our players. We're doing our best to solving all these problems. But we have to prioritise the bugs, softlocks and exceptions. Due to the limited manpower, it will take some time for some of the bugs to be fixed before they updated. So in order to avoid those troubles, we will explain the major issues that we have received a lot of feedback on:

[h3][b]0. We will close the cloud save feature temporarily.[/b][/h3]
We found the reason that some players' Screen Blackout problem is the corruption of our savedata files. When the files were uploading to the cloud, and the data is lost after re-syncing.
[b]So we decide to close this function for now until we have fixed the upload compatible.[/b] 
You will need to bring your saving files if you want to log in some other place.

[h3][b]1. The character's data are the previous character's data when entering the module with a newly created character.[/b][/h3]
You need to re-enter game, and then re-choose the character to solve this bug for now.


[h3][b]2. The screen are black when I choose re-battle after being defeated.[/b][/h3]
We have added some precautions at this time, but we're still not sure that we have fully fixed the issue. So if you encounter this problem, [u][b]please click the [Space-Time Backtracking] button to enter the battle again.[/b][/u]

[h3][b]3. If you cannot move when you came back to the Space-time Temple and several models appeared.[/b][/h3]
Now you can [u][b]click the button 'Reset the Mainlobby' which can be found in settings[/b][/u] to clean the wrong data.
We're trying our best to find its reason and fix it.


[h3][b]4. After entering the prologue module(All-in-One and One-in-All), the character keeps going to the top left and cannot be controlled[/b][/h3]
You can [u][b]click the button 'Restart the scenario', which can be found in settings[/b][/u], to clean wrong data.
We're trying our best to find its reason and fix it.
 

[h3][b]5. The effect of buffs which equipped in the previous module such as mythical items are not successfully cleared after scenario settled.[/b][/h3]
You need to create a new character and then inherit this scenario's record to clean the wrong datas.
We will remove the Space-time points consumption for character creation in the next update.  


[h3][b]6. We are trying our best to fix the bug that your character's ability doesn't change in the Interlude.[/b][/h3]


[h3][b]7. If you meet a softlock which appears when you're loading and cannot enter the game.[/b][/h3]
We need to collect wrong data because maybe there're different reasons in different computers.
So if you have met this problem, please change your game to the beta version.
[u][b]Right click→ Properties→ BETAS→ enter 'rgjt2022test'→ check code→ choose test version.[/b][/u]
Then send the Error messages to us. ([u]In our Discord, you can send the messages in the channel #bug-report or DM Admins.[/u]


[h3][b]8. If your FPS is lagged and the character's move speed is very low.[/b][/h3]
Please DM the Admins in our Discord.
Very appreciate, we're trying our best to solving it.


[h3][b]9. The last time you quit the game due to an exception and re-entered, if the game goes to black after the logo appeared.[/b][/h3]
Please copy [u]\AppData\LocalLow\MeowNature\Depersonalization-Release[/u] to your 'My computer' address screen. [b]Then delete the SteamSaveRecord file and the TempRecord file.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/fcd8f16984bc9d08572dca72f4ab56f3f229da82.png[/img]


[h3][b]10. If you met the problem that your computer has a Screen Blackout, a Blue Screen of Death and reboot.[/b][/h3]
You can change your game to the window mode and try again.

notes.title: Pre EA Release Notes
notes.content:
[h3][b]Important things[/b][/h3]
Right now we're focusing on getting EA version online as soon as possible for PC. 
——Unfortunately, due to the shortage of cash on hand, we can only rely on the free trial food in the grocery store to survive.
（The cat at home is also ready to go to the cat cafe to work(･ω´･ )）
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/f68a5a746a96ded27b7b5330ad0fc6a113f9bd3e.png[/img]
Unexpectedly, it has been 18 months since the project was established. Looking back, from the old draft version of the game, to this version, that finally made me reluctantly satisfied. I would like to thank all the investigators for their kindness.
Now that the time is tight, we can no longer polish and evolve. After the system framework is finalized, the game will be extended to the future with the current systems. If the next version of "Depersonalization" does not satisfy everyone, unfortunately, we cannot make further changes at the current time, thank you for understanding.
After the important things, the following is the new work report to all the investigators.


[h3][b]What have we done during this time[/b][/h3]
Although many people say that in the early stage of many independent games, only two can be selected between the graphics, system, and plot. However, we still spent a quarter of the time making up more game systems.
Let us show you the hot and fresh pie~

[h3][b]Temple of Time-space[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/1c2061601dfd7c3a89b5ad531985ec302c6573e0.png[/img]
Anan and Sotos have a place to live, and the place to expand the new system in the future is also guaranteed~

[h3][b]Create Character[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/ff65fabfd90752e8d38fa4a3ad468d0be638d58b.png[/img]
Here, you can create an investigator. After entering, you will see that four basic investigator models can be chosen. Finally, you don't need to work for each module evey time Anan!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/f9b670d1932399d0fce8b94657a47df9d4a11541.png[/img]
The trait feature is on the right side of the investigator, which was previously mentioned to provide the role-playing solution in video games.
Characters will have four types of traits, suffering, personalities, perception, and experiences.
Suffering, personalities, and perception cannot be changed. Currently, personalities will affect the choice of events, and perception will determine the response of spiritual power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/fa09af1a6d3affa478295db35f7277e41ef81743.png[/img]
Although innate things cannot be changed, we can use our experiences to constantly improve ourselves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/12b1897aaecea974386ede4e20d7b4cbbac7b92b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Interlude Module[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/e337711842d7455a6a177de33c10bb59be619090.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/06d2da0b6b8b194c1e1a7b0fd80d67fcc3cd77ed.png[/img]
In order to easily increase the game time in the future, bah, it is convenient for the game to carry out multiple different forms of creation. We have added the text game as the character's interlude story. In the text game , you can experience the fun of the single-player TRPG module ( strongly recommend Chaosium's "Alone against the flames" module). I don't know if you will be interested in it, but I hope you will enjoy it and have fun.
It is worth mentioning that the experience trait can be obtained at the end of the text game.

[h3][b]Custom Mod[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/886ca383d3b4c329a9352658d0336ae2826a6882.png[/img]
Then there is the custom module function, which of course has not been opened yet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/fba01d41b806ec12001da37156c8e8bcfbe4fe53.png[/img]

[h3][b]Exploration Module[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/8e4775f242731c42f20b9f8a4fc151c6d7e793dc.png[/img]
Thousands of books stored by Sotos can be seen on the shelves. Each book also represents each module’s story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/d2d8c3d00c9399d5d883660ab1c3ecb11d0283ab.png[/img]
And our KP will no doubt be Sotos!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/e8e745cedcaecb9a9981981636e1792153d4a5e1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/1e56e2ea702ee6b0ef9f40b8d4e0d7d9f91c0cca.png[/img]
If you can clearly see through the distance, please SanCheck yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/1780a91dfd824285c6cb16540b1985bef72105b3.png[/img]
Enter the Gate, select your own connected character, and the tour will begin, and occupation-related items will be given to the character at this time.

[h3][b]Spell system[/b][/h3]
Use the mysterious books in the backpack, and after successful study, you will find that we have finally implemented the spell system!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/5e2e5e385d1db2ea2d9efe5c40843aaf87a8a318.png[/img]

[h3][b]Combat system[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/697d60db9c92798444e17b07dd9289e88d580197.png[/img]
In order to restore the COB(Call of Bilibili) TRPG experience and promote the "normal" TRPG battle process, we have implemented various PL's whimsy into combat behaviors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/b18639f33ddc9ae318676331bf024ed88ed839ef.png[/img]
When encountering an unbeatable enemy, now investigator can -- just run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/b14f2b16bc32f21814895ca302106625dbbf15db.png[/img]
If you win, you can search and get some loot.

[h3][b]Time Points & Projection Items[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/73eba49dea8993ac7b9b6c97a3e8f9a4354af134.png[/img]
As long as a certain branch result is reached, the settlement can start, and the character that had been used will not be able to reenter the mod after settlement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/3fafff453f093e290e701fe8c6362f37193763b6.png[/img]
All the resources obtained will be recycled into the power of Sotos (space-time points), the more achievements you have, the more clues you get, the more space-time points you will get.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/191f2d1839ecf72a259634505736fcedadc1126a.png[/img]
Time-space points can be used in various systems in the temple of time-space in the future. Currently, it can be used to project "Imbalance" equipment, and to rewrite the fate of the connected character.
The points will be consumed in the interlude module.

[h3][b]New Module[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/b70309046d0e529b3ed714453c2d375173efaaa3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302266/65c1a582097f8e38d642f218e307c0e820079eca.png[/img]
At present, the exploration model of "Soladnit" has been implemented. Investigator will investigate together with Shaye.  Finally, we are no longer fighting alone.


[h3][b]Q&A[/b][/h3]
[b]Q：Contents of the PC-EA version[/b]
A：Four exploration mods, "All For One", "Lies and Fraud", "Soladnit", and "Welcome to Arkham."
Seven Interlude Modules
The linear flow of each exploration module storyline will be around 1 hour
PS：If there is time, there will be a new version of the battle mod. (It's usually too late, don't believe the nonsense of the development team!)

[b]Q：New Demo and EA Release[/b]
A：There will be a new demo version in June (warning: the more systems, the less content in the game, jk), and the lie and fraud mod will return.
The EA version will be released in late 2022, and the main work is to fill in all the mod content planned for the current version.

[b]Q：Plans for the official version after EA[/b]
A：In the next 12 months, the visual configuration interface in the game will be completed, and the functional custom module will be completed.
